title: REQ · server.New registers and implements no execution, approve or retry routes
summary: server.New and the admin route table contain only round admin routes
description: Context: server.New builds routes under /api/v1/admin from adminRoundRoutes. Desired behavior: that table lists only the five round routes and New builds no execution store, handler, worker or config dependency. Expected result: execution, approve and retry paths are unreachable. Why: remove development automation from the server.
acceptance_criteria: Given server.New, when GET /api/v1/admin/executions and POST /api/v1/admin/executions/x/approve and /retry are sent with the admin token, then the status is 404 or 405
Given adminRoundRoutes, when listed, then it has exactly the five round routes (create, open, close, get, contributions)
Given the server sources, when scanned, then no execution or worker import remains

preserve: adminRoute struct and adminRoundRoutes table shape
